ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image display: ABCD is a large rectangle, A is at the upper left, B is at the upper right, C is at the lower right, D is at the lower left; E is located on the left side AD, G is located on the lower side DC; the line segment EF from E to the right and the line segment GF from G upward together enclose the small rectangle DEFG at the lower left. According to the problem statement, E is the midpoint of AD, and G is the midpoint of CD. Let AD = h and CD = w, then the area of the large rectangle ABCD is hw = 72. method.method_draft: First describe the diagram: ABCD is the large rectangle, with D at the lower-left corner; E lies on side AD and G lies on side DC, and segments EF and FG complete the smaller rectangle DEFG in the lower-left part of ABCD. From the text, use that E is the midpoint of AD and G is the midpoint of CD, and the area of ABCD is 72. Let AD = h and CD = w. Then DE = h/2 and DG = w/2, so area(DEFG) = (h/2)(w/2) = hw/4. Since hw = area(ABCD) = 72, area(DEFG) = 72/4 = 18.
